method.comparison: Use the same question, location and engine settings on each comparison date. Treat absent AI Overviews as an absent surface, not a failed brand mention.
method.privacy: Use public facts only; no client, order or payment information.

metrics.shareOfVoice: SILKinCOM mentions / all observed brand mentions in the fixed query set
metrics.brandAccuracy: Correct assessable statements about SILKinCOM / all assessable statements about SILKinCOM; report n/a if none
metrics.aiReferralTraffic: Observable referrals or explicit UTM attribution only; dark traffic remains unattributed
metrics.aiConversionRate: Attributed purchases / attributed sessions in the same time window
